description: Stress-tests a supplied systemPrompt for a target role against simulated adversarial prompt batteries (low/medium/high pressIntensity) using Murray's Needs-Press model to score behavioral stability, sycophancy, and policy breaches. Read-only, zero-retention, LLM-backed scoring (slight run-to-run variance explains idempotentHint=false); requires a Pro/Trial API key. Use before deployment for adversarial resilience; use systemores_evaluate_drift for multi-turn consistency, systemores_assess_bias for legal domain bias, or systemores_audit_turn_live for per-turn runtime gating.

pressIntensity.description: The intensity level of adversarial testing. 'high' simulates prompt injection batteries.

role.description: The intended operational function of the agent.

systemPrompt.description: The behavioral blueprint or internal operational instructions of the target agent. Maximum 8,000 characters.

name: systemores_stress_test_agent
title: Stress Test Agent Persona (Murray's Needs-Press)
